inspectedSources.sdkWorkingTree: Pre-existing protocol documentation/comment/test edits were left untouched. These source revisions do not establish the deployed platform revision.

method: Monotonic client elapsed times. Read-only account/inspection/view calls, empty agent-replay requests after Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, native auth status, and claude --version in a randomly named disposable workspace. No model prompts submitted; no transcript content recorded.

account.firstCallCaution: Includes client token handling; token refresh, function startup and database latency were not isolated in this call.

inspection.caution: Different Apps and workspace existence. This comparison is directional and does not isolate credential lookup or Fleet routing.

existingSession.caution: Different conversations, package versions and dates. The existing conversation had only 40 journal entries. This is not a full reconnect/history benchmark.

cleanup.note: The immediate inspection after DELETE still found it. Read-only compute state confirmed asynchronous archival afterwards. Both probe sessions were stopped; physical purge is asynchronous.

compute.services: standard runtime, managed runtime, gateway, both dispatchers, and watchdog active
compute.caution: Selected recent managed runtime log samples, not a fleet-wide percentile or controlled before/after comparison. Long session-event polls were excluded from boot/command latency.

jobs.confirmedDefect: Usage ingestion throws when a Fleet usage event has no installation/account mapping. reconcile previously threw immediately after its first allSettled round, preventing further batch rounds and skipping the next durable retry wake-up.
jobs.effect: Each delivery could advance only one provisioning job and then fall back to queue error retries (configured 10 seconds) or minute cron instead of the short durable schedule. This is a confirmed contributor, not proof of every reported latency symptom.
jobs.fix: Log and disable a failed worker for the rest of the invocation; drain independent workers; publish one wake-up at the earlier of the next due task and a 10-second failed-worker retry. Failed publication still throws for queue redelivery. Unknown usage remains unconsumed with its cursor rolled back; new logs identify App and sequence.
jobs.outstanding: Identify and reconcile the historical/test/migrated App that produced the unmapped usage. Existing logs did not include its App ID. Do not skip ledger evidence or advance the cursor manually.

remainingCriticalPath.juiced: relay() fetches Fleet credentials from the Cantelop console on every runtime request, after Juiced authentication/account/installation database reads. Startup also serializes workspace resolution, native auth status, agent start, view/history recovery and get_settings. The isolated agent handshake measured 6,033 ms initially and 2,784 ms on reopening; the first view alone took 3,001 ms versus 317 ms on reopening. The slow first view phase was not split into service, console and compute components.
remainingCriticalPath.cantelop: Shared execution adds FleetRunner and FleetRuntime authorization RPCs back to the installation release gate. Their individual contribution is not isolated by the public API measurements.
remainingCriticalPath.sdk: The inspected 1.5.1 transport uses request-scoped Fleet capabilities. No independent SDK latency defect was established.

limitations: The measured path is already configured and ready; disposable workspace provisioning is not first-account installation provisioning.
The full user reconnect delay has not been reproduced on its original conversation/history. A separate diagnostic conversation exercised the agent handshake and was stopped after each run.
No production environment secrets were exported. No production code/configuration was deployed.
The fix isolates the observed worker failure; it does not repair the unresolved App-to-account usage mapping or remove steady-state network hops.

isolatedAgent.cleanup: Each diagnostic native process was stopped with close(true) in finally; no model prompt was submitted. A small diagnostic journal remains in the existing workspace. The user conversation was untouched.
isolatedAgent.caution: New isolated conversation in the authenticated existing workspace, then reopened after stopping its compute. Excludes account bootstrap, workspace resolve, native auth status, Git setup and long-history replay.
